scope: Restore the user-selected original tool charging behavior while retaining transactional saves, entry/lifecycle guards, protected board cells and request idempotency.

original_reference.correction: Original undo already checked for a selectable step before charging. The previous blanket claim that all no-target free uses were introduced by the refactor was inaccurate.

behavior: Each successful new request_hint charges its configured price and replaces the token, even on the unchanged board. Applying that hint does not charge again.
Repeating the same committed sequence returns its receipt without another charge. Insufficient inventory or failed commit neither replaces the token nor advances the sequence.
An accepted locate attempt charges even with no candidate, using a successful no_effect receipt. It increments use statistics but fabricates no cat, history, animation or completion.
Undo with no selectable step stays free. A selected editable history step is consumed even if its cells already equal their before values; history is removed atomically with its charge.
Missing normal hints remain free, SP fallback stays locate, existing free policies remain effective, and ad rewards replenish inventory without automatically using the tool.
retained_guards: No action during failed/pending entry or after page completion/close
No debit on real storage failure
No new storage schema or generic host protocol
